name: APL
typeSystem: Dynamic; every value is an array, including rank-0 scalars. Many scalar primitives apply pervasively, while other functions operate on whole arrays or cells according to rank, shape, and conformance rules.
runtime: Historically interpreted directly from its distinctive symbolic notation; modern implementations remain primarily interpreters, although Dyalog can compile selected functions to a more efficient internal bytecode.

runtimes.name: GNU APL / Dyalog APL (interpreter)
runtimes.role: Interprets APL's array expressions directly, applying its built-in operators across whole arrays at once.

compilers.name: Dyalog APL
compilers.role: Commercial interpreter with an optional compiler that converts selected functions to internal bytecode.

concurrencyModel: Implementation-dependent; Dyalog APL provides explicit parallel array operations and futures/isolates for concurrent tasks.
